name: memory_write
description:
Writes or updates a persistent fact in the agent memory store.
Use when: storing decisions, preferences, project details, or any key-value data that should persist across sessions and clients.
Scope: local filesystem (~/.config/agentic-store/memory/facts.json). No network access.
Not for: logging events (use memory_log), saving session snapshots (use memory_checkpoint), or retrieving facts (use memory_read).

value.description: Value to store. Can be a string, number, boolean, list, or object.

category.description: Optional grouping label. Example: 'project', 'preferences', 'context'. Defaults to 'facts'.
